title: Australia news live: Victorian premier condemns anti-immigration protests; Sydney marathon under way with Olympic champions
summary: An anti-immigration protest called March for Australia is set to take place in cities across the country on Sunday. Follow today’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Good morning and it’s a welcome from me, Graham Readfearn , to our live news blog for this Sunday. The search for Dezi Freeman , the alleged killer of two Victorian police officers, enters its sixth day. Police arrested a 61-year-old man late yesterday in nearby Bright, but have not confirmed if the arrest is linked to the search for Freeman. Continue reading...

title: Real Madrid beat Mallorca in La Liga, scoring twice in two minutes
summary: Real Madrid score twice in two minutes against Mallorca as they come from behind to maintain winning La Liga start.
